throughline.zh: 本週資料涵蓋東南亞能源與資料中心計畫、泰國電子材料新廠、越南前段晶圓建設進度，以及台灣電子製造自動化與跨境設備供應鏈的不同執行階段。
throughline.en: This week's data spans Southeast Asian power and data-center plans, Thailand's new electronics materials plant, Vietnam's front-end wafer-fab progress and Taiwan-linked factory automation and equipment supply.

title.zh: 稀土、PCB 材料與新廠產能進度
title.en: Rare earths, PCB materials and production capacity

summary.zh: 工研院規劃稀土示範廠，仍待預算與廠址；騰輝 10 月 26 日在泰國大城府啟用 PCB 銅箔基板與黏合片工廠，並開始小量出貨。2030 年稀土目標與泰國廠年底量產均尚非實際產能。
summary.en: ITRI's rare-earth demonstration plant remains unfunded and unsited, while Tenghui opened its Thai PCB laminate and prepreg factory on October 26 with small initial shipments. The rare-earth 2030 goal and Thai volume ramp are future targets.

title.zh: 工廠電力復原、AI 自動化與精密設備
title.en: Grid restoration, factory AI automation and precision tools

summary.zh: 台電於 10 月 25 日公布宜蘭復電進度，沒有晶圓廠停機損失資料；鴻海與 NVIDIA 26 日公布特定工廠排程工時降低 25% 的測試，JIMTOF 亦在東京開展，台灣公會表示 94 家廠商參展。各數值來自不同場景，不適合直接比較。
summary.en: Taipower completed household restoration in Yilan without fab downtime data. Foxconn and NVIDIA reported a 25% scheduling-hour reduction for selected workflows on October 26, and JIMTOF opened in Tokyo with 94 Taiwanese exhibitors according to an association. These metrics measure different activities.

title.zh: 東南亞海纜、機房投資意向及跨境供電
title.en: Southeast Asia cables, data-center intentions and cross-border power

summary.zh: MViSTA 海纜仍在招標、馬國總理提出 500 億美元資料中心投資意向；新加坡 EMA 於 26 日有條件核准 1.3GW 跨國低碳電力輸入，預定 2035 年啟動。三項進展分別為規劃、意向與條件性核准，非已完成建設。
summary.en: MViSTA's cable remains in tender, Malaysia's prime minister cited a US$50B data-center intention, and Singapore EMA conditionally approved a 1.3GW power import plan for 2035. These are tender, intention and conditional approval stages, not finished infrastructure.

title.zh: 光互連、貨運與 SMT 設備事業結構
title.en: Optical interconnects, cargo and SMT equipment structure

summary.zh: 玉晶光與 3M 的 EBO 光互連產品尚未公布量產驗收，長榮航管理層 25 日說明高科技貨運需求；Reuters 26 日則報導 ASMPT 的 SMT 設備業務潛在出售競標。已公開的上半年接單、九月營收和潛在交易估值屬不同口徑。
summary.en: GSEO and 3M have not announced qualified EBO production, EVA Air discussed high-tech freight demand on October 25, and Reuters reported potential bids for ASMPT's SMT unit on October 26. Historical bookings, freight revenue and possible deal valuations are not directly comparable.

title.zh: 東南亞晶圓製造及半導體合作
title.en: Southeast Asian wafer-fab development and semiconductor cooperation

summary.zh: 駐菲代表提出台菲半導體走廊合作方向，並引述 2030 年電子出口目標；Reuters 26 日實地報導 Viettel 越南晶圓廠仍無建築、DUV 設備未成交，但 Viettel 表示按階段推進。兩國均未在本週披露新晶圓廠已完成裝機。
summary.en: Taiwan's envoy discussed Philippine semiconductor corridors and a 2030 electronics export goal. Reuters reported Viettel's Vietnam fab lacked buildings and a finalized DUV order, while Viettel maintained phased progress. No newly commissioned front-end fab was established.
